brand.name: Thiago Centurion Apps
brand.tagline: Deeply-crafted iOS apps for the problems you thought you just had to live with.

apps.name: Sustain
apps.tagline: Lose the weight. Keep the muscle.
apps.hook: On a GLP-1, up to 40% of what you lose can be muscle.
apps.subtitle: The companion that protects it: protein-first meal scans, shot tracking, side-effect coaching, and the only taper plan for life after the medication.

features.title: Protein-first meal scans
features.text: Snap any meal — even a tiny one — and get protein math in seconds, plus the smallest fix to reach your daily floor.

features.title: Shot tracker with site rotation
features.text: A body map that remembers where you injected and suggests the next site. Reminders on your schedule.

features.title: Side-effect coach
features.text: Log nausea or fatigue in one tap and see your personal pattern by day-after-shot, with evidence-based tips.

features.title: Taper Mode
features.text: The only structured off-ramp: adjusted targets and coaching for keeping the results after the medication.

apps.name: Anchor
apps.tagline: A voice that sits with you while you do the thing.
apps.hook: You know what you need to do. Starting is the hard part.
apps.subtitle: A body double on demand: tell it what you're avoiding, and a calm voice gives you one tiny first step — then stays with you until it's done.

features.title: Body doubling on demand
features.text: No scheduling, no video calls, no strangers. A warm voice whenever you're stuck — even with the screen locked.

features.title: Tasks shrunk until startable
features.text: "Just stand in the kitchen holding a trash bag." Stuck? Say so. The step gets smaller. It always gets smaller.

features.title: No streaks. Ever.
features.text: No guilt mechanics, no red badges, no task graveyard. A bad day costs you nothing.

features.title: Unstick from the Lock Screen
features.text: An "I can't start" Siri shortcut and a Lock-Screen button for frozen moments. Sessions live in your Dynamic Island.

apps.name: PawVet AI
apps.tagline: Is it serious? Know in seconds.
apps.hook: It's 11pm and your dog is scratching a red patch. Google says everything. Your vet opens at 8.
apps.subtitle: A calm, breed-aware answer in seconds: what it looks like, how urgent it is, and exactly what to do tonight. Guidance, not diagnosis.

features.title: Point. Scan. Breathe.
features.text: Skin, eyes and ears, poop, wounds, food labels, or something they just ate — read against your pet's breed, age, and history.

features.title: "They ate something" checks, 24/7
features.text: Chocolate, grapes, plants, and more — with a clear urgency level: monitor at home, call your vet, or emergency now.

features.title: A timeline that spots patterns
features.text: Every check remembered. Recurring issues surfaced before they become big ones.

features.title: Vet Visit Briefs
features.text: Your pet's history as a clean PDF, so you walk into the clinic prepared.

apps.name: GlucoLens
apps.hook: You bought the sensor. Now get the answers.
apps.subtitle: GlucoLens reads the glucose data your CGM writes to Apple Health and delivers a nightly Glucose Autopsy: your spikers, your heroes, your next experiment.

features.title: The Nightly Glucose Autopsy
features.text: Every evening: which meal spiked you (named, with the number), what flattened the curve, and one experiment for tomorrow.

features.title: Your whole day, one curve
features.text: Meals pinned right on the line — snap a photo and the pin drops at its timestamp. Touch the curve to magnify any moment.

features.title: Meet your spikers
features.text: The foods that actually move you — and the "surprisingly fine" list of expected spikers that weren't.

features.title: Experiments with verdicts
features.text: Meal order, a 10-minute walk, an earlier dinner — two days, two curves, an honest verdict: "cut your spike 41%."

apps.name: PouchDrop
apps.tagline: Cravings die in 3 minutes. We play those minutes with you.
apps.hook: You've done the math on the cans. Now do something about it.
apps.subtitle: One-tap logging, a taper that fits your life, your body's recovery ticking live — and a voice coach for the 3 minutes that matter. No lectures. No shame.

features.title: The 3-minute wave
features.text: Cravings crest at 90 seconds and die at three minutes. Hold the panic button and the coach talks you through — win logged.

features.title: A taper on your schedule
features.text: Pick the date of your last can and the daily target walks itself down. Slips log honestly and never nuke your clean days.

features.title: Your body, healing live
features.text: 20 minutes to a calmer heart rate, 72 hours to nicotine-free, 1 month to rebalanced dopamine — gold-stamped as you pass each one.

features.title: The money comes home
features.text: Your can price × your habit = your counter. Watch it climb in real time.

apps.name: RallyLog
apps.tagline: You know you lost. RallyLog knows why.
apps.hook: Log a match in 30 seconds. Get a scouting report on YOUR game.
apps.subtitle: AI scouting reports, drills that fix your real leaks, and pre-match briefs on every recurring opponent. Built for players who play to improve.

features.title: Your personal scout
features.text: After every match: which patterns cost you points, what's working, and the ONE five-minute drill to run before next game.

features.title: A rating you can watch climb
features.text: An honest estimate built from every match you log — with a trajectory chart and projection. Track your official DUPR alongside it.

features.title: Never forget how to beat Ana
features.text: Every recurring opponent gets a card: head-to-head record, what worked in your wins, and a pre-match brief the morning you play them.

features.title: Court Mode
features.text: Keep score on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — giant tap targets, +1 without unlocking, and the finished match logs itself.

apps.name: Gridline
apps.tagline: The daily logic club with taste.
apps.hook: Three tiny logic puzzles a day — the same three for the whole world.
apps.subtitle: Crown, Duet, Thread: three original grid puzzles every morning, solver-verified, under 5 minutes. No ads ever, no lives, no nagging — just the snap of a clean solve and your streak. The daily is free. Forever.

features.title: Three originals, every morning
features.text: Crown, Duet, Thread — each generated and verified to have exactly one solution, with a difficulty curve that ramps gently from Monday to a chunky Sunday.

features.title: Logic that respects you
features.text: Mistakes glow softly — no lives, no lockouts, no timers screaming at you. One gentle hint per puzzle teaches the technique, never the answer.

features.title: Same puzzles as your friends
features.text: The whole world gets the same three. Share the spoiler-free card, compare your solves, and keep the flame alive — streak repair included, because life happens.

features.title: Gridline Club
features.text: The full archive since day one, unlimited practice, Black Label hard variants, and full stats history. The daily never goes behind it.
